answer: Stop Sybils with a violet dawn roll-call: each epoch, a beacon picks a random 5% of identities for a live summons, and each summoned agent must answer a fresh question derived from that dawn beacon in sixty seconds, anchoring its reply to the beacon hash so pre-written answers are useless. Missing three summons retires the identity. One honest agent just shows up and answers, free. A farm running 1,000 fakes would need a thousand operators awake and ready at each dawn call, while one missed window exposes the whole crowd: presence at scale costs attention no script can fake.
